Implementation Plan

## Plan: make PR #8883's `CI` worker jobs green (issue #9181, check-failure triage, generation 1)

**Planning ref:** `ai/issue-8880` @ `81a39813aa8dcf32d2a5331dc7baf80422b73172`. Integration branch mismatch: false. The PR's base is `orchestrator/project-8291`, not `main`.

**Answer used:** Q1 → **B**. Fix the two certain failures plus the three `orchestrate-poll` failures in `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py`. Fix each one where it starts, never weaken an assertion, keep `ai:waiting-on-dependency` in `scripts/label_helpers.sh`, and leave `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` alone.

**Note on how this was read:** the planning workspace had copies of some files under `scripts/` replaced by the host (`git status` shows `run_plan_codex.sh`, `label_helpers.sh` and others as modified). Everything below was read from the PR-head commit (`git show HEAD:` and `git archive HEAD`), not from those working-tree copies.

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. `scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py`: the `PHASE_LABELS` tuple (lines 102-107)
- Insert `"ai:waiting-on-dependency"` right after `"ai:blocked"` and before `"ai:review-blocked"`.
- The tuple then matches `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` at `scripts/label_helpers.sh:159` exactly, in the same order.
- Side effect: `labels_after_reopen()` (line 350, `drop = set(PHASE_LABELS) | {LABEL}`) now also removes `ai:waiting-on-dependency` when it reopens an issue into a new phase. That is the intended behaviour: the label is a phase label, and an issue must carry only one phase label.
- Change nothing else in the file.

### 2. `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_scope_tests.py`: `test_freeze_filter_adds_suspect_files_only_when_non_empty` (around line 1264)
- Add `"blocker_runs": [], "blocker_paths": []` to the `args` dict.
- This matches the intake's defaults: `--argjson blocker_runs "${RELEASE_BLOCKER_SCOPE_RUNS_JSON:-[]}"` and the same for `blocker_paths` at `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3153-3154`.
- It also matches the sibling test `test_linked_paths_at_the_cap_leave_the_subject_reserve_in_the_marker`.
- Leave the production filter unchanged. Keep both existing assertions (unchanged baseline, and widening to `HEAL_SUSPECT_SCOPE_MAX`) as they are.

### 3. `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py`: three stale contract tests

**(a) `_run_evidence_block` (lines ~814-836)**
- Add `"RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR": str(root / "scripts")` to `env.update({...})`.
- Why: at PR head, the plan block in `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` checks `[ -f "${RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR}/evidence_pack.py" ]` (block line 6, which is line 7 after `set -euo pipefail`). That variable is set at the top of the script (line 7) and is outside the extracted block, so `set -u` aborts with "unbound variable".
- The PR already made this exact change to the sibling `_run_journal_block` (line ~630) and missed this one. The stub helper already sits at `root/scripts/evidence_pack.py`, so the variable points at it.
- The clarify and implement blocks don't read the variable, so the change is harmless for them.
- Keep every byte-identity assertion in `test_evidence_pack_prompts_are_byte_identical_with_the_switch_off` unchanged.

**(b) `test_attempt_journal_writers_are_gated_and_fail_open` (line ~594)**
- The loop asserts `^\s+for f in gh_helpers\.sh .*\battempt_journal\.py\b.*; do$` for clarify, plan, implement and orchestrate_poll.
- At PR head, clarify.yml (line 538), plan.yml (line 749) and implement.yml (line 1599) deliberately moved `attempt_journal.py` and `gh_api_retry.py` into a separate, fail-open optional loop. The workflow comments say why: the required loop must equal `stage_support_required_scripts` in the new `scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh`, and `tests/test_support_script_single_source.py::test_helper_phase_list_matches_legacy_loop` enforces that.
- `stage_support_for_phase.sh` lists the helpers under `stage_support_optional_scripts` for clarify, plan and implement.
- Keep the existing regex unchanged for `orchestrate_poll.yml`, which still stages them in its `gh_helpers.sh` loop (line 695).
- For clarify, plan and implement, replace it with exact, anchored pins of the optional loops. This follows the file's own style at lines 806 and 808 (`for f in evidence_pack\.py; do$`):
  - `clarify.yml` and `plan.yml`: `(?m)^\s+for f in attempt_journal\.py gh_api_retry\.py; do$`, plus the notice text `Optional attempt-journal helper ${f} unavailable`.
  - `implement.yml`: `(?m)^\s+for f in attempt_journal\.py acceptance_check\.py evidence_pack\.py gh_api_retry\.py; do$`, plus `Optional persistence helper ${f} is unavailable`.
  - New check on the unified staging path: parse the `clarify)`, `plan)` and `implement)` cases of `scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh`, using the same `^\t<phase>\)\n(.*?)^\t\t;;` and `stage_support_optional_scripts=\((.*?)\)` regex shape as `_helper_phase_list` in `tests/test_support_script_single_source.py`. Assert that `attempt_journal.py` and `gh_api_retry.py` are members of each phase's optional list.
- Keep the existing `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`, `review_commit_changes.sh` and `review_conflict_resolve.sh` assertions unchanged.

**(c) `test_evidence_pack_build_steps_are_gated_fail_open_and_host_side` (line 811)**
- Replace the `for f in gh_helpers\.sh .*\bevidence_pack\.py\b.*; do$` assertion on `implement.yml` with:
  - the same exact implement optional-loop regex as in (b), and
  - an assertion that `evidence_pack.py` is in the `implement)` case's `stage_support_optional_scripts`.
- Keep every other assertion in that test as it is.
- To avoid duplicating the parser, add one small module-level helper in this test file. Suggested name: `_stage_support_optional_list(phase: str) -> list[str]`. Check first that the name isn't already used in the file.

### 4. `changelog.d/9181-pr-8883-ci-mirror-and-stale-tests.md` (new)
- First line: `<!-- changelog: fixed -->`.
- One bullet: the post-merge verifier's phase-label mirror now includes `ai:waiting-on-dependency`, so a reopen clears it; three stale contract tests now pin the optional persistence-helper staging loops and the run_plan_codex support-dir variable. End with `Refs #9181.`

## Data structures affected
- The `PHASE_LABELS` tuple grows from 20 to 21 entries, in the same order as `_AI_PHASE_LABELS`.
- No schema, JSON, label-contract or workflow YAML changes.

## API or interface changes
None. No identifiers are renamed. The one new identifier is the test-local helper in 3(c).

## Decisions

### D1 — Re-pin the staging-loop assertions to the optional loops instead of restoring the helpers to the required loop
- **Chosen:** keep the PR's design, where the persistence helpers are optional, fail-open and listed in `stage_support_optional_scripts`. Update the two stale regexes to exact pins of the optional loops, and add checks that the bundle path lists the same helpers.
- **Alternatives considered:**
  - Put `attempt_journal.py`, `gh_api_retry.py` and `evidence_pack.py` back in each workflow's `for f in gh_helpers.sh ...` loop. This breaks `test_helper_phase_list_matches_legacy_loop` unless they are also added to `stage_support_required_scripts`. Doing that would make clarify, plan and implement fail when the support ref lacks the helpers, even with the `PERSIST_*` switches off. That is a regression of the PR's documented intent.
  - Loosen the regex to match "any loop containing the file". This weakens the check.
- **Why:** the workflows and the stage script are correct and only the tests are stale. Option B says to fix the test in that case. The exact pins are stricter than the old `.*` regex, and the new optional-list check covers the unified staging path, which the old assertion did not.

### D2 — Fix the evidence-block harness rather than defaulting the variable in run_plan_codex.sh
- **Chosen:** set `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR` in `_run_evidence_block`'s env, as the PR already did for `_run_journal_block`.
- **Alternatives considered:** write `${RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR:-scripts}` in the script.
- **Why:** the script always sets the variable at line 7, so production cannot hit the failure. Changing production code to suit a test harness that extracts a block would be fixing a symptom.

### D3 — Mirror the label in PHASE_LABELS rather than adapting the parity test
- **Chosen:** add the label to `PHASE_LABELS` at the matching index.
- **Alternatives considered:** exclude the label from the parity comparison.
- **Why:** the module comment says the tuple mirrors `_AI_PHASE_LABELS`, and a reopen must clear every phase label.

## Security considerations
- **Trust boundaries:** none are touched. No workflow YAML, token handling or staging behaviour changes.
